content: Weaviate is an open-source vector database built for AI applications.
It supports hybrid search combining dense vectors with BM25 keyword search.
Weaviate can be deployed locally, on Kubernetes, or as a managed cloud service.
Embedding models convert text into dense numerical vectors that capture semantic meaning.
Models like BAAI/bge-m3 support multiple languages and long context windows up to 8192 tokens.
OpenAI's text-embedding-3-small produces 1536-dimensional vectors and is cost-effective.
RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) combines a retriever with a generative LLM.
The retriever finds relevant documents; the generator produces an answer conditioned on them.
Recall@K measures what fraction of relevant chunks appear in the top-K retrieved results.
MRR@K (Mean Reciprocal Rank) measures the average inverse rank of the first relevant result.
